STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast or snack tray with a muffin, a slice of bread, a cup of tea with milk, a small cup of yogurt, and two creamer/sugar packets. Photographed from a near-frontal, slightly elevated angle, with a colour calibration card in the foreground.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The bread plate and muffin plate are paper plates, roughly 17 cm in diameter (area ≈ 3.14 × 8.5² ≈ 227 cm²). The tray is about 40 cm wide, which supports this scale. Plate size is taken from the bread plate; the muffin plate is similar.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Muffin (savoury, with bits of seed/nut topping, about 7 cm across and 5 cm tall)
- Slice of white/sourdough-style bread (about 12 cm × 8 cm, roughly 2.5 cm thick)
- Yogurt cup (about 7 cm diameter, 8 cm tall, roughly 150 g container)
- Tea with milk in a mug (about 250 ml, mostly milk)
- Two creamer/sugar packets (about 5 g each)

STEP 4 - Area: Items are scored against the tray and plates, not a single vessel, so I estimate by footprint on the tray.
- Muffin: ~25 cm² on plate
- Bread slice: ~45 cm² on plate

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Muffin: ~25 cm² × 4.5 cm ≈ 110 ml (dome shape reduces this to ~85 ml)
- Bread slice: ~45 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 110 ml

Yogurt and tea are estimated from container size rather than volume envelopes: yogurt ≈ 150 g (full cup), tea ≈ 200 g.

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Muffin: 85 ml × 0.6 (dense baked good, lower than bread) ≈ 55 g. A muffin of this visible size typically weighs 60–70 g, so I use 60 g.
- Bread slice: 110 ml × 0.3 (bread-like, airy crumb) ≈ 35 g. A thick slice of this size usually weighs 45–55 g, so I use 50 g.
- Yogurt: 150 g (full cup as seen)
- Tea with milk: 200 g
- Creamer packets: 2 × 5 g = 10 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Muffin: 60 g × 380 kcal/100 g ≈ 228 kcal
- Bread: 50 g × 265 kcal/100 g ≈ 133 kcal
- Yogurt (fruit-style, full-fat): 150 g × 110 kcal/100 g ≈ 165 kcal
- Tea with milk: 200 g × 45 kcal/100 g ≈ 90 kcal
- Creamer packets: 10 g × 400 kcal/100 g ≈ 40 kcal (estimated)

Total: about 260 g of food and drink, roughly 656 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The total is plausible for a full breakfast tray with a muffin, bread, yogurt and milky tea. Per-item weights are consistent with the visible sizes.
